definitions.ask: How should the coder repair the live bob-cli plans clone once the fix is in?
definitions.why: Lossless, but it writes to another project's primary checkout, so you see the command first

choices.label: You approve the exact repair command via /sase_gate before bob-cli's checkout is touched
The coder runs the one-shot repair itself after just check passes and reports it
The clone stays broken until you reinstall sase; the hourly digest error continues

definitions.ask: Should the coder also crash-harden every repo on your machines via the chezmoi global gitconfig?
definitions.why: Only an unattended SASE clone was damaged; machine-wide fsync is a personal trade-off
